addon_boundaries.boundary: Scriptable as a job: set scene.quadwild_props / scene.quadpatches_props, select target mesh, call the operator. Headless-safe.
Import-only on the Blender side; calibration happens in the external fSpy app. Import, then verify the scene camera.

MODAL/BLOCKING VIEW_3D tools. Launch-only in a GUI session; never automated retopology. Non-modal helpers: cgcookie.retopoflow_newtarget_cursor, cgcookie.retopoflow_newtarget_active, cgcookie.retopoflow_continue_active.
Enable-first: the artist's startup.py disables keentools at startup (POLICY, not an error). Re-enable and verify the pykeentools core before calling. Pin modes are modal and excluded.
Scriptable but STATEFUL: acts on the active scatter system configured via property groups. Set node/group inputs by socket NAME.
Bridge-only call targets (VIEW_3D context operators); no code ported.
UNVERIFIED: operator surface not opened in research. Do not advertise capabilities for these.

forensic_findings.absent_veins: Across 15 files: ZERO embedded texts, ZERO NLA, ZERO drivers, ZERO annotations; fake-user datablocks are factory data plus ONE artist item (SprayNodes_Final in Bottle2). No rejected-takes pattern exists for her.
forensic_findings.bottle_chain_evolution: Spray sockets 7 -> 18, node tree 29 -> 74 nodes, AgX -> Filmic, EEVEE -> CYCLES between Bottle and Bottle2.
forensic_findings.rotted_links: SKYNpatches_Updated genuinely has rotted texture links (//Bags/grace.png, //Bags/ignite.png, a Crave box texture, a Mac-mini Dropbox path), verified at ORIGINAL paths. Missing-file checks on copies are provisional: '//' paths resolve against the copy's location and lie.
forensic_findings.uuid_lineage: The scene 'uuid' custom property is IDENTICAL across Bottle -> Bottle2 -> Bottle3: a same-file lineage fingerprint. Use it to group versioned series.

hard_guards: Never auto-append or auto-attach missing linked assets; report them (scene.health).
Missing fluid/point cache = report, never auto-rebake.
KeenTools disabled-by-startup is POLICY, not an error state to fix.
Migration reads the saved version, works on a copy, and preserves the original file.
Inspect first, rename never by default: her naming (heroes semantic, support geometry factory-named, functional collections like boolean_cutters / Reference / RigidBodyWorld) carries information.
Never modify her original .blend files; open read-only, copy to scratch for any test that saves.

history_limits.fact: A .blend file contains NO operator history, NO undo steps, NO Info-editor log, NO repeat history. All session-only RAM (Blender Manual + window-manager write path in source). Never claim otherwise.
history_limits.fossil_record: What files DO hold: unapplied modifier stacks in order, node trees (incl. orphaned/muted nodes), embedded Text datablocks, actions/NLA/drivers, custom properties, annotations, tracking data, point caches, and fake-user datablocks (the only unused data that survives a save).
history_limits.never_recoverable: Within-session operator sequence/parameters, undone or deleted-and-saved work, applied-modifier parameters, brush strokes, per-step time, authorship.
history_limits.timeline_method: Diff the backup chain (.blend1 older -> .blend newest) and versioned filename series at datablock level. Granularity is one snapshot per save, never per operation.

version_adapter.addon_availability: Per-version, never assumed: her 5.1 config has the full addon stack + startup.py; her 5.2 config has NO addons migrated and NO startup.py.
version_adapter.blend_header: Blender 5.0+ writes a 17-byte header (BLENDER17-01v0502) and zstd-compresses by default; a naive 7-byte BLENDER magic check rejects her newest files. Never sniff magic bytes; open through Blender.
version_adapter.eevee_engine_id: BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT for 4.2-4.4; BLENDER_EEVEE before 4.2 and again from 5.0.
version_adapter.principled_renames: 4.0 renamed Principled inputs (Subsurface Weight, Specular IOR Level, Transmission Weight, Emission Color); read inputs by current names per running version.
version_adapter.slotted_actions: Blender 5.3 removed legacy action.fcurves for Slotted Actions; it silently reads 0 keyframes. Correct read: bpy_extras.anim_utils.action_get_channelbag_for_slot(action, slot). Verified totals: Bottle = 158 keyframes / 7 actions; Bottle3 = 232 / 7.
